notes.title: A New Mystery Unfolds: The Last Case of John Morley
notes.notes:
[p]From [b]Indigo Studios[/b], the creators of [i]Charon’s Staircase[/i], [i]Seven Doors[/i], and [i]Portrait of a Torn[/i], comes a brand-new psychological detective adventure.[/p][p]Dive into a haunting and dark story of crime, obsession, and hidden truths…
Where every revelation only deepens the mystery.


[b]🔎 The Story Awaits[/b]

· [b]First-Person Investigation[/b] – Explore richly detailed environments, from eerie mansions to abandoned sanatoriums, searching for hidden clues.[/p][p][b]· Puzzle-Solving & Scene Reconstruction[/b] – Analyze evidence, connect the dots, and recreate the crime scene to uncover what really happened.[/p][p][b]· Immersive 1940s Atmosphere[/b] – A gripping noir-style story, enhanced by a haunting soundtrack and period-accurate settings.[/p][p][b]· A Suspenseful Storyline[/b] – A 3-hour narrative-driven experience filled with unexpected twists and a shocking finale that will linger long after the game ends.
[/p][p][b]Coming Soon on Steam, PlayStation and Xbox
Add it to your wishlist and prepare to uncover the last case![/b][/p][p][url="https://indigostudios.one"]https://indigostudios.one[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636620/The_Last_Case_of_John_Morley/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Achievements Now Available!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that achievements have officially been implemented in Portrait of a Torn.
Thank you for your continued support—we hope you enjoy unlocking each achievement along the way!

notes.title: Incorporation of Additional Languages and Load System Fix
notes.notes:
Localizations have been added for [b]French, Italian, German, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Catalan. [/b]

The issue with the CONTINUE button has also been fixed, which previously prevented some saved games from loading correctly and caused the game to freeze during loading. 

Minor bug fixes and improvements.
